missions.synopsis: Recover the missing team ledger. Cross the containment sector, disable its anchor and extract through the emergency lift.
missions.title: BLACKOUT AT SITE-7

briefing.speaker: COMMAND
briefing.text: The first anchor is offline, but its carrier did not stop. Re-enter through the service uplink and follow the lower relay chain.

briefing.speaker: MICA
briefing.text: The flooded maintenance run still has active security sensors. I can trace their firing lanes; use the machinery as cover.

briefing.speaker: ROOK
briefing.text: Recover the reserve cache before the quarantine crossing. A second anchor means another shield cycle. Keep an escape lane open.

briefing.speaker: ASTER
briefing.text: Routing log first, relay second. Extract early if the squad cannot continue. Full clearance opens the core approach.

post_mission.speaker: MICA
post_mission.text: The routing log isolates the final carrier path. It runs beneath the bulkhead into the resonance core.

post_mission.speaker: COMMAND
post_mission.text: Recovery sweep complete. Refit at base; Core Pressure is now available.

missions.synopsis: Follow the lower relay chain through flooded maintenance. Recover the routing log and disable the sublevel sentinel.
missions.title: RECOVERY SWEEP

briefing.speaker: COMMAND
briefing.text: The relay is down. Its log exposes the core approach. Recover the carrier trace before entering the bulkhead.

briefing.speaker: ROOK
briefing.text: More armored drones, no clear corridor. Use the barriers, reload behind machinery and move on the warning gaps.

briefing.speaker: MICA
briefing.text: The final anchor has a stronger core. Its central iris is the emitter; the shield phase still blocks our shots.

briefing.speaker: ASTER
briefing.text: Secure the resonance sample, disable the anchor, then reach the escape shaft. No one stays behind.

post_mission.speaker: MICA
post_mission.text: Site-7 is silent. The resonance sample still carries a trace toward the offshore network.

post_mission.speaker: COMMAND
post_mission.text: Chapter 01 complete. All three operations remain available for recovery runs and upgrades. The offshore operation is not deployed yet.

missions.synopsis: Breach the inner defense, recover the carrier trace and shut down the resonance anchor. Return through the escape shaft.
missions.title: CORE PRESSURE
